(823)rgyal chen sku lnga'i gsol mchod bsdus pa bzhugs/hūm̐/spros bral chos kyi sku las longs sku'i gdangs/rigs lnga gangs chen mtsho yi sgyu 'phrul ga

tei:div.tei:p: rgyal chen sku lnga'i gsol mchod bsdus pa bzhugs/ hūm̐/ spros bral chos kyi sku las longs sku'i gdangs/ rigs lnga gangs chen mtsho yi sgyu 'phrul gar/ legs bsgyur bcom ldan padma dbang chen gyi/ yang sprul dregs pa'i gtso bo bāe ha ra/ sku gsung thugs yon phrin las rgyal po lnga/ yab yum sras 'khor mngag gzhug sran g.yog bcas/ dngos bshams yid sprul mchod tshogs 'di bzhes la/ bdag dang bslang bya'i mi mthun (824)phyogs kun zhi/ tshe bsod dpal 'byor stobs rgyas gang 'dod yid/ dbang bsdus dgra bgegs brlag sogs rab 'byams las/ yongs 'grub bstan 'gror phan bde rgya chen por/ sbyor nus mthu stobs nus pa phun tshogs mjod/ ces pa'ang rdo grub chen rin po ches gsungs so//
